commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 31 and broader indices lagging—Nifty Midcap down 0.11% and Smallcap easing 0.01% while the Nifty 50 advanced solely on large-cap IT—our market gate flashes WEAK. In the teachings of Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil, an index advance without broad participation is a classic distribution signature. A selective, bifurcated tape demands progressive exposure: no new full-sized positions, aggressive trailing stops, and absolute scrutiny on individual volume and earnings confirmation. Under SEPA discipline, when the tide does not lift all boats, only true market leaders displaying accelerating fundamentals and tight Stage 2 consolidation deserve watch status, while speculative beta and cash instruments must be avoided.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini (SEPA), O'Neil (CANSLIM), Weinstein (Stage Analysis), Darvas & Livermore

21STCENMGM.technical: Price trades above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, logging a 3.89x volume surge on a double-bottom base breakout with RSI at 70. However, micro-cap liquidity characteristics and erratic overhead supply diminish breakout sustainability.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Capital-market trading firm with highly erratic mark-to-market income. FY26 posted consolidated net losses and an abysmal ROE of -70.8%, lacking institutional sponsorship and stable operating margins required by O'Neil's CANSLIM criteria.
21STCENMGM.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below base pivot support at 42.82. Execute swift stop-loss discipline to prevent micro-cap illiquidity traps.

63MOONS.technical: Positioned within 1.5% of its 958.91 pivot, holding EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 1.99x volume expansion. RSI at 61 displays constructive momentum, though upper wick resistance reflects persistent supply at recent highs.
63MOONS.fundamental: Pivoting toward cybersecurity with 63SATS scaling revenue, but consolidated operations recorded a steep ₹47.6 Cr net loss in Q1 FY27. Negative operating margins and poor capital return ratios fail CANSLIM quality thresholds.
63MOONS.risk: Failure occurs on a breach below the 872.77 stop level, violating key moving average support. Respect the stop immediately.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidating within 1.5% of its 110.11 pivot above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 66 shows constructive positioning, but volume remains tepid, failing to confirm institutional accumulation into the neckline.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals are deteriorating: Q1 FY27 revenue plunged 56% YoY and net profit dropped 26%. Weak ROE (3.1%), negative top-line trajectory, and declining promoter holdings fail O'Neil's leadership standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breakout thesis invalidates if price breaks below the 100.50 stop level. Disrespecting the stop risks severe drawdowns in illiquid conditions.

AARTIIND.technical: Clearing its 20-session high at 552.3 on 1.41x average volume, the stock confirms a SEPA Stage 2 continuation. Price action holds firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with RSI at 56 offering clean entry headroom.
AARTIIND.fundamental: Textbook CANSLIM acceleration: Q1 FY27 revenue expanded 41% YoY with PAT surging 227% as EBITDA rose 79%. Capacity expansion in fuel additives to 360 KTPA and margin expansion offset debt leverage, validating genuine institutional demand.
AARTIIND.risk: Thesis fails on a reversal back below 514.53, violating the breakout pivot and 21 EMA. Cut losses immediately.

ANGELONE.technical: Displays a powerful SEPA breakout clearing 20-session highs at 323.32 on 2.49x volume. Holding cleanly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, the pattern exhibits classical institutional accumulation with RSI at 63 indicating high relative strength.
ANGELONE.fundamental: High-conviction CANSLIM characteristics: Q2 FY27 PAT jumped 58.2% YoY with revenue up 18.9%, driven by an expanding client funding book and 44.8% EBITDA margins. High historical ROE (~29%) and operating leverage reflect strong institutional sponsorship.
ANGELONE.risk: Failure occurs if price undercuts 303.40 stop level, reversing back into the prior range. Adhere to Minervini's rapid stop execution.

AONELIQUID.technical: An overnight cash ETF charting a near-flat NAV trajectory tracking 1-day repo rates. Price above averages and minor volume spikes represent treasury cash parking rather than a speculative equity Stage 2 breakout or VCP.
AONELIQUID.fundamental: Instrument is an exchange-traded liquid debt mutual fund scheme holding overnight money market instruments. CANSLIM fundamental metrics (EPS, revenue, ROCE, promoter holding) are non-existent and inapplicable to cash management vehicles.
AONELIQUID.risk: Thesis fails instantly for momentum trading. While downside price risk is negligible, parking growth capital here yields zero equity alpha.
